regles.source:
rule "omni-v5-ad-adcs-modele-ca"
when
  (to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_channel) == "Security" &&
   (to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4882" || to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4885" || to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4890" || to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4892" || to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4899" || to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4900")) ||
  (to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "5136" &&
   (lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ObjectClass)) == "pkicertificatetemplate" ||
    lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ObjectClass)) == "pkienrollmentservice" ||
    lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ObjectClass)) == "certificationauthority" ||
    contains(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ObjectDN)), "cn=public key services,")) &&
   !(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectUserName)) == "bx-pki2022$" &&
     to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_AttributeLDAPDisplayName) == "cACertificateDN" &&
     contains(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ObjectDN)), ",cn=aia,cn=public key services,")))
then
  set_field("v5_tag", "adcs_modele_ca");
  set_field("v5_severite", "ELEVE");
  set_field("v5_mitre", "T1649");
  set_field("v5_entite", lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectUserName, to_string($message.source))));
  set_field("v5_detail", concat(concat("AD CS modifie (evenement ", to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id)), ")"));
end

rule "omni-v5-ad-adcs-san"
when
  (to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4886" &&
   regex("(?i)(nom principal|principal name|autre nom|other name|upn=)", to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectAlternativeName)).matches == true) ||
  ((to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4886" || to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4887") &&
   regex("(?i)(^|\\n)\\s*san:", to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_Attributes)).matches == true) ||
  (to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4887" &&
   regex("(?i)(?:nom principal|principal name)=([^@\\s]+)@", to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectAlternativeName)).matches == true &&
   lowercase(to_string(regex("(?i)(?:nom principal|principal name)=([^@\\s]+)@", to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectAlternativeName), ["u"])["u"])) !=
     lowercase(to_string(regex("([^\\\\]+)$", to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_Requester), ["r"])["r"])))
then
  set_field("v5_tag", "adcs_san");
  set_field("v5_severite", "CRITIQUE");
  set_field("v5_mitre", "T1649");
  set_field("v5_entite", lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_Requester)));
  set_field("v5_detail", concat(concat(concat("Demande ", to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_RequestId)), " SAN "), to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectAlternativeName)));
end

rule "omni-v5-ad-dcsync"
when
  to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "4662" &&
  (contains(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_Properties), "1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2", true) ||
   contains(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_Properties), "1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2", true) ||
   contains(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_Properties), "89e95b76-444d-4c62-991a-0facbeda640c", true)) &&
  lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectUserName)) != "bx-ad-01-it-vm$" &&
  lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectUserName)) != "bx-ad02-it-vm$" &&
  lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectUserName)) != "iv-it-ad-vm$" &&
  lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectUserName)) != "msol_0123456789ab"
then
  set_field("v5_tag", "dcsync");
  set_field("v5_severite", "CRITIQUE");
  set_field("v5_mitre", "T1003.006");
  set_field("v5_entite", lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectUserName)));
  set_field("v5_detail", concat("Replication d'annuaire demandee par ", to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SubjectUserName)));
end

rule "omni-v5-ad-lsass-lecture"
when
  to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "10" &&
  ends_with(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_TargetImage)), "\\lsass.exe") &&
  regex("^0x[0-9a-fA-F]*[13579bdfBDF][0-9a-fA-F]$", to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_GrantedAccess)).matches == true &&
  !((lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage)) == "c:\\program files (x86)\\ninjaone\\ninjarmmagent.exe" || lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage)) == "c:\\program files\\ninjaone\\ninjarmmagent.exe" ||
     lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage)) == "c:\\program files (x86)\\ninjaone\\njbinarymetering.exe" || lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage)) == "c:\\program files\\vmware\\vmware tools\\vmtoolsd.exe") &&
    to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_GrantedAccess) == "0x1410") &&
  lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage)) != "c:\\windows\\system32\\csrss.exe" &&
  lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage)) != "c:\\windows\\system32\\wininit.exe" &&
  !((regex("^c:\\\\programdata\\\\microsoft\\\\windows defender\\\\platform\\\\[0-9.\\-]+\\\\msmpeng\\.exe$", lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage))).matches == true ||
     lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage)) == "c:\\program files\\windows defender\\msmpeng.exe" || lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage)) == "c:\\windows\\system32\\mrt.exe") &&
    (to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_GrantedAccess) == "0x1010" || to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_GrantedAccess) == "0x1410" || to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_GrantedAccess) == "0x1418")) &&
  !(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage)) == "c:\\windows\\system32\\msiexec.exe" &&
    contains(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_CallTrace)), "\\perfproc.dll+"))
then
  set_field("v5_tag", "lsass_lecture");
  set_field("v5_severite", "CRITIQUE");
  set_field("v5_mitre", "T1003.001");
  set_field("v5_entite", lowercase(to_string($message.source)));
  set_field("v5_detail", concat(concat(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_SourceImage), " masque "), to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_GrantedAccess)));
end

rule "omni-v5-ad-service-tier0"
when
  to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_id) == "7045" &&
  (lowercase(to_string($message.source)) == "bx-ad-01-it-vm" ||
   lowercase(to_string($message.source)) == "bx-ad02-it-vm" ||
   lowercase(to_string($message.source)) == "iv-it-ad-vm" ||
   lowercase(to_string($message.source)) == "bx-pki2022" ||
   lowercase(to_string($message.source)) == "iv-it-pki-vm" ||
   lowercase(to_string($message.source)) == "vm-paca-ad1") &&
  !(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ServiceName) == "VeeamVssSupport" &&
    contains(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)), "c:\\windows\\veeamvsssupport\\veeamguesthelper.exe") &&
    starts_with(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_user_name)), "gmsa-sauvegarde")) &&
  !starts_with(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)), "\"c:\\program files\\eset\\") &&
  !starts_with(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)), "\"c:\\programdata\\eset\\remoteadministrator\\") &&
  regex("^(\\\\systemroot\\\\)?system32\\\\drivers\\\\(eamonm|ehdrv|eelam|epfw|epfwwfp)\\.sys$", lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath))).matches == false &&
  !starts_with(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)), "\"c:\\program files (x86)\\ninjaone\\") &&
  !starts_with(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)), "\"c:\\program files\\ninjaremote\\") &&
  regex("^\"c:\\\\program files \\(x86\\)\\\\exempleorganisation-[0-9.]+\\\\(njvmagent|nmsmanager|ninjarmmagent|ninjarmmagentpatcher)\\.exe\"", lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath))).matches == false &&
  !starts_with(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)), "\"c:\\program files\\vmware\\vmware tools\\") &&
  regex("^(\\\\systemroot\\\\)?system32\\\\(drivers|driverstore\\\\filerepository\\\\vm3d\\.inf_amd64_[0-9a-f]+)\\\\(vm[a-z0-9_-]*|vsock|vmci)\\.sys$", lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath))).matches == false &&
  !(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)) == "c:\\windows\\system32\\dllhost.exe /processid:{480b4670-6610-4465-b6c5-e9b5c4e0da31}") &&
  lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)) != "c:\\windows\\sysmon64.exe" &&
  lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)) != "c:\\windows\\sysmondrv.sys" &&
  !starts_with(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)), "\"c:\\program files\\winlogbeat\\winlogbeat.exe\"") &&
  !starts_with(lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)), "\"c:\\programdata\\microsoft\\windows defender\\platform\\") &&
  regex("^system32\\\\drivers\\\\(wd\\\\[a-z0-9]+|ksld)\\.sys$", lowercase(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath))).matches == false
then
  set_field("v5_tag", "service_tier0");
  set_field("v5_severite", "ELEVE");
  set_field("v5_mitre", "T1543.003");
  set_field("v5_entite", lowercase(to_string($message.source)));
  set_field("v5_detail", concat(concat(to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ServiceName), " -> "), to_string($message.winlogbeat_winlog_event_data_ImagePath)));
end
